office_does: The sheriff is Jefferson County's chief law enforcement officer, running patrol, investigations and the jail; four-year term.
race_blurb: Only Sheriff Andy Pernsteiner, appointed in 2025, is on the ballot; a write-in candidate has registered with the PDC.

candidates.summary: Jefferson County Sheriff since his 2025 appointment, a 28-year member of the office and former undersheriff; the only name on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed sheriff Feb. 24, 2025, after six years as undersheriff [S5][S1]
Wants partnerships on substance abuse, homelessness and mental health [S1]
Opposed Senate Bill 5974 on oversight of sheriffs [S7]
